facts.fact: Google Local Service Ads charge per lead rather than per click, according to the Adwave article.
facts.quote: Unlike regular Google Ads, you pay per lead, not per click.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $100-200/month for Google Local Service Ads.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $100-200/month gets you meaningful data.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $50-100/month for TikTok Ads.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $50-100/month is enough to test.

facts.fact: The Adwave article states that the minimum daily budget for TikTok campaigns is around $50.
facts.quote: Minimum daily budget is around $50 for campaigns.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $100-300/month for YouTube ads.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $100-300/month provides useful data.

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV ads have a 94% completion rate, compared with social media's lower completion rates.
facts.quote: CTV ads have 94% completion rates (compared to social media's fraction of that).

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV advertising can be started for $50, with AI creating the ad.
facts.quote: **The surprising truth:** You can start for $50, and AI creates the ad for you.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $50-500/month for Connected TV advertising.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $50-500/month. Start small, test, and scale what works.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $50-100/month for Nextdoor Ads.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $50-100/month can reach meaningful local audiences.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a starting budget of $50-150/month for Pinterest Ads.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $50-150/month provides useful data for most businesses.

facts.fact: Adwave states that many industries report Facebook CPM increases of 30-50% compared to pre-iOS 14.5 levels.
facts.quote: Many industries report CPM increases of 30-50% compared to pre-iOS 14.5 levels.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends planning for new Facebook ad creative every 2-4 weeks.
facts.quote: Plan for new creative every 2-4 weeks.

facts.fact: Apple introduced App Tracking Transparency in 2021, which Adwave says changed how Facebook ads work.
facts.quote: When Apple introduced App Tracking Transparency in 2021, it fundamentally changed how Facebook ads work.

facts.fact: The page gives LinkedIn ads a starting budget of $200-500 per month.
facts.quote: **Starting budget:** $200-500/month. LinkedIn is more expensive than other platforms, but lead quality is often higher for B2B.

facts.fact: The page says the 70/20/10 budget allocation framework directs 70% of ad budget to proven channels.
facts.quote: **70% goes to proven channels.** Whatever is working now, even imperfectly, continues to get the majority of your budget.

facts.fact: Under the 70/20/10 framework, 20% of the ad budget goes to promising tests of new channels.
facts.quote: **20% goes to promising tests.** New channels that have shown initial results get room to prove themselves.

facts.fact: Under the 70/20/10 framework, 10% of the ad budget goes to experiments with wild-card channels.
facts.quote: **10% goes to experiments.** Wild card tests with channels you're curious about. Low risk, potential high reward.

facts.fact: For a $500 monthly ad budget, the page allocates $350 to established channels, $100 to a new channel test, and $50 to experiments.
facts.quote: For a $500 monthly ad budget, that means $350 to your established channels, $100 to test something new, and $50 to experiment.

facts.fact: The page recommends giving a newly tested channel 30 days before judging results.
facts.quote: Test one new channel at a time. Give it 30 days before judging results.

facts.fact: The page states that TV advertising platforms now allow testing with as little as $50 to $100.
facts.quote: For TV, platforms now allow testing with as little as $50 to $100.

facts.fact: The page recommends running channel tests for at least two to four weeks before drawing conclusions.
facts.quote: Run tests for at least two to four weeks before drawing conclusions.

facts.fact: The page states that Apple's iOS 14 update limited tracking capabilities, making Facebook ad targeting less precise.
facts.quote: Privacy changes like Apple's iOS 14 update limited tracking capabilities, making targeting less precise.
